annotations.title: Remove the easy AI-sounding habits from writing

description: Rewrites the easy tells: swaps em dashes for commas, chatbot words for plain ones, strips assistant filler, markdown stars and emoji bullets, fixes stiff transitions. Habits that need a human rewrite ("it's not X, it's Y", fake suspense, rule of three) are listed but left alone. Returns the fixed text, the before and after score and what remains.

categories.description: Optional: only fix these categories. Default: every auto-fixable category.

text.description: The writing to clean up (up to 60,000 characters).
